biography.en:
She is a Chinese manhua artist. She is best known for creating the comics Zi Bu Yu and Chang Ge Xing, and five million copies of her works have been sold as of 2018. Her art has been noted for its classical style, and have been met with positive reception in both China and Japan. In 2008, she won the Gold Prize in the girls’ category of the fiction section, the Fifth OACC Golden Dragon Award Original Animation & Comic Competition, the biggest one in China of its kind.

Her interests had included painting and comic-reading since she was a child, and she was eventually inspired to make her own comics in high school. She published her first work, titled Cheng Zhang, in the Beijing Cartoon magazine, receiving an encouraging, handwritten reply by her editorial teacher. After graduating from university, she moved to Beijing and briefly worked in advertising before quitting to focus on her own comics. During this time, she became engrossed in drawing, seldom leaving her apartment as she lived on a modest income.

Alternate names:  夏達, Ся Да, 하달

description.en:
Adapted by Hong Kong artist Lee Chi Ching from the Jin Yong novel of the same name.  
  
The comic's initial part of the story revolves around a highly coveted manual containing a powerful martial arts technique known as the "Evil Exorcising Swordplay". The manual is an heirloom of the Lin family, who run the Fortune Prestige Agency, a private security and escorting service in Fuzhou. Yu Canghai, the leader of the Qingcheng Sect, leads his followers to massacre the Lins and attempts to seize the manual for himself, but does not find it. Lin Pingzhi, the sole survivor from the Lin family, is saved by Yue Buqun, the head of the Mount Hua Sect, which is a member of the Five Mountains Sword Sects Alliance. Yue Buqun accepts Lin Pingzhi as an apprentice and trains him in swordplay.  
  
Meanwhile, Yue Buqun's most senior student, Linghu Chong, an orphaned, happy-go-lucky and honourable swordsman who has a penchant for alcohol finds himself befriending the notorious bandit Tian Boguang and saves Yilin, a nun from the (North) Mount Heng Sect, from Tian's lecherous advances.  
  
However, that is just the beginning of a series of escalating conflicts as various individuals take to extreme measures to attain the manual as well as achieve their personal goals.

description.en:
An accident forced two handsome schoolboys who originally disliked each other to bind together in a love game. Chi Che became a game player, while Cen Huang’s soul left his body to become a game system. In order to return back to normal, both player and system can only brace themselves and complete the rest of the game’s strategy missions. What’s outrageous is that the attack target is unexpectedly Cen Huang’s soulless body?! Thus, a straight guy helping another straight guy pursue his own dramatic love game has now begun…

A dangerous control freak senior who refuses to socialize x an optimistic talkative junior who lacks love.

In the complicated modern day society, eight people with different personalities, different social classes, different occupations, different interests, different life experiences and different dreams, for some reason, have moved under the same roof and met with each other. This encounter produces many comedic situations. In this colourful cohabitation, these eight people who are considered ordinary in society, might break out of their shells or achieve their ideals. They'll finally break free of the shackles on their hearts and "become immortals".

After 40,000 years of trials and tribulations, humanity has established a vast empire spanning the galaxy. However, evil gods, insectoids, Orcs, and traitors! These enemies of humanity have inflicted innumerable wounds on this colossus. Humanity, raising the banner of survival, has seen countless loyal bones scattered across the wilderness. Yet, the enemies of humanity have now breached the barriers of time and space, aiming to strangle humanity in its cradle. The skeletal Emperor, bridging two epochs alongside a cursed child, will embark on this grand and tumultuous saga!

Ruan Yunshu, the top star of the second generation who is lying and winning, is forced to exchange her soul to Tao Yan, a 38-line artist who is being suppressed and seeking the rule of gold. Under pressure, she desperately wanted to contact the past and regain her lover. Tao Tao, who occupies Ruan Yunshu's body, also launched a sniper attack on Ruan Yunshu in the face of his long-respected gold broker brother and various male gods who were previously unavailable!

Zhou Ming Yu, a college student who possesses the bizarre power called Tiangou [Heavenly Dog], which is targeted by various powerful forces in the warlock world. In order to eradicate the influence of Tiangou [Heavenly Dog] on himself and to find the truth of his father’s death, a mysterious incident that happened more than a hundred years ago in Kunlun Mountain is unveiled….

Her name is Orange. She's a young girl in high school, coming of age in the heart of the city. And she has decided she has nothing to live for. Not her shallow friends. Not her parents. Not school. Not even the empty promise of love. Her head filled with morbid fantasies of suicide, Orange finds herself standing at the edge of her rooftop when the drunken, enigmatic young man, Dashu, entered her world changing it forever.  
  
A heartbreaking tale of a young woman desperately trying to understand the bewildering world around her, brought to life by the luscious artwork of global manga icon, Benjamin, Orange is a profoundly moving story of loss and redemption.

description.en:
The blind Duchess regained her sight—only to witness her fiancé cheating on her that very day. Determined to take revenge on the scumbag and reclaim her family title, she made a bold move at the wedding—swapping grooms and marrying the infamous, devilishly handsome fugitive instead! Thus begins the tale of a Duchess and a wanted man, where marriage comes first and love follows later. (Cr TL: Gourmet Scans)

----
The Duke's Daughter Windsor lost her parents in a car accident several years ago, and she herself was left blind. Supported by her fiancé and her younger sister—who is not related to her by blood—she somehow managed to get by day to day.

However, after secretly undergoing treatment and regaining her sight, Windsor discovers that the two have betrayed her and are plotting to take over the dukedom.

Driven into a corner, Windsor sets out to ask the person who treated her eyes for help in ruining the wedding ceremony—but she mistakenly approaches the wrong man.

That man is Theodore, the head of Blark Bank, who is currently being pursued by the police after being falsely accused of a crime by none other than Windsor’s fiancé.

With their interests aligned, Theodore proposes a contract marriage to Windsor.

How will the two of them confront and overcome the hardships ahead…?

Amidst the chaos of a shattered life, Yu Zhou faces a crisis: discouragement that threatens her career as a writer. Everything seems to be falling apart — until an unexpected encounter changes her course. Xiang Wan, a mysterious and resilient woman who claims to have traveled back in time from Imperial China, appears in her life as a breath of hope.

With her ancestral courage and peculiar vision of the modern world, she helps Yu Zhou find the strength to move forward. However, fate has another surprise in store: Yu Zhou's literary work is adapted into an audio drama, and the protagonist chosen to give voice to the story is none other than Su Chang, her ex-girlfriend. The reunion of the two rekindles dormant memories and feelings, creating a delicate emotional triangle.

Note: This is the new version. The cancelled version has been removed from Bilibili.

description.en: An ancient guardian spirit comes to me when I start to look for the truth behind my parents' disappearance. He calls me master and wants to stay with me… After launching an investigation into the incident, my lost memories begin to resurface…

Mrs. Meng took advantage of a poor opportunity to reincarnate into the world so she could safe her loved ones from the past life. However, due to the loss of the seal in the mirror, Meng Po was unable to restore her memory after the rebirth. So when she met the lover of her previous life, she couldn't help falling in love with him again. At the same time, he was caught in a dangerous conspiracy.

title.en: Vampire Kokoro and Human Misaki - BanG Dream! (Doujinshi)

description.en: A vampire AU with Kokoro and Misaki.

title.en: Take the Crown, I Want to Be a King

description.en:
A young boy with a terminal illness was caught up in an incident and obtained a system , that could cure him, but in exchange, he has to defeat the nine people with great superpowers.  
  
He accepts the task, and later found that the system has provided him with a skill [Domination] , which makes all his defeated enemies to listen to his commands no matter what !  
  
  
chinese  
身患顽疾，时日不多的高中生元吾，在遭遇意外，获得超自然系统后，了解到只要击败九个异能高手，就能让身体痊愈。男主毅然接下任务，并发现系统已赋予自身一个叫做“王权”的技能，那便是亲手打败的敌人，必须无条件听从自己一次命令！

title.en: Let's Take the Train Together, Shall We?

description.en: When your mundane routine of taking the train to work suddenly becomes both interesting and troublesome after striking up an odd almost-friendship with someone who's your polar opposite.

title.zh-ro: Duànjué Guānxi hòu, Wǒ de Zhàohuànshòu Quán shì Hēi'àn Shēngwù

altTitles.en: After Severing Our Ties, All My Summons Became Dark Creatures
After Breaking off the Relationship, All my Summoned Beasts Were Dark Creatures

altTitles.pt-br: Depois de Romper os Laços, Todas as Minhas Invocações se Tornaram Criaturas das Trevas

altTitles.zh: 断绝关系后，我的召唤兽全是黑暗生物

description.en: After being backstabbed by his own brother, the ultimate warrior Gu Chen regresses to his 18-year-old self right before his class awakening. In his past life, despite being abandoned in a farming village by his father and oppressed by his stepmother and brother, Gu Chen still treated them as family, and his constant compliance led to his ultimate betrayal. Armed with a second chance and now fused with the Blood of the Demon King, he decides to walk a different path. He cuts ties with his toxic family and chooses to become a Dark Summoner, leveraging his overpowered talent and past-life knowledge to embark on an unstoppable path of leveling up.
description.pt-br: Após romper todos os laços com aqueles que o cercavam, ele descobre que suas invocações passaram por uma transformação inesperada. Todas as suas feras invocadas se tornaram criaturas das trevas, dotadas de poderes misteriosos e assustadores. Agora, enquanto desvenda a verdadeira natureza de suas novas companheiras, ele terá de enfrentar um mundo que jamais imaginou conhecer.

description.en: An ordinary salesman transmigrated to a Xianxia world and is known as the good-looking Lu Changsheng. Due to his godly looks, people think he's a genius, but he actually has mediocre talent. His master wants him to be Elder Senior Brother, but will he be able to pull it off with just looks?

What if your buddy surprisingly became the most beautiful girl in your school?!! My old best friend, Xu Wen, came back in a beautiful girl’s body, and I have to pretend to be “his” boyfriend. However, our funny campus life is not as peaceful as it seems; strange and creepy happen now and then…

title.en: Only You Are What I Love, Not This World

altTitles.en: I Don't Like This World, But I Only Like You

description.en: This is a memoir of a couple. It records their warm and lovely stories, by telling their teenage stories in a humorous tone. The heroine is tough and independent, and her partner has been by her side for 10 years. Here you may feel how sweet love could be, and how touching and uncommon life could be.

title.en: After Crossing the Catastrophe, I Became the Skeleton Demon Supreme

altTitles.zh: 渡劫后我变成了骷髅魔尊

description.en: The master of the Li Huan Demon Palace, Li Tian, who has been secluding himself to cultivate the Li Huan Demon Sutra, expected to become an unparalleled handsome man after overcoming his tribulation. To his shock, he turned into a fragile skeleton that shatters with the slightest touch! In order to reclaim his physical body, he resolutely embarks on a journey to gather his own harem…
description.id: Penguasa istana Istana iblis Lihen, Li Tian, ​​​​yang telah berlatih buku iblis Lihen, berpikir bahwa dia akan menjadi pria yang tampan setelah melewati malapetaka!  Untuk mendapatkan tubuhnya kembali, dia dengan tegas memulai perjalanan haremnya...

altTitles.en: Wei Jun is not afraid of dying

description.en: After finding out that he becomes invincible after dying, Wei Jun began finding ways to die frantically. Then, he discovered that something was wrong with the world. He knocked the rich kid to the ground, but the rich kid instead praised him and asked for another slap. He scolded the Emperor like a dog, but the Emperor swore that Wei Jun shall have immunity for life. He forcibly embraced the waist of the proud and unsociable goddess, but she just said that she will only be his from now on! Wei Jun: “Stop it! I just want to die, why is it so hard?”
description.zh: 魏君确认自己被杀死后就能直接无敌，于是他开始疯狂作死。然后，他发现这个世界有毒。 他把纨绔干翻在地，纨绔夸他打得好，最好再来一巴掌。 他把狗皇帝骂到狗血淋头，狗皇帝竟发誓护他一世周全。 他替天煞孤星女神捕撑腰，神捕表示这辈子只能以身相许了。魏君：别闹！我只是想死，怎么就这么难呢？
